text:
read the bible.txt file and tell me the changes made

Unless you’ve managed to perform some divine alchemy so that two versions move as one, I’m going to need a bit more info. 

To tell you what changed, I actually need *two* files (or at least the original text and the new version). Otherwise, I'm just looking at one file wondering if someone silently swapped out "thou shalt" for "you should." 

Drop both versions here—or tell me what specific section you're worried about—and I'll run a diff to see what's going on.
title: Auto-learned conversation
